title: How often should I service my AC in Al Sufouh?
desc: For many residential systems, servicing every 3 to 6 months is a practical schedule. ACs used heavily may need more frequent attention.

title: Why is my AC cooling slowly?
desc: Slow cooling can happen because of dirty filters, blocked coils, weak airflow, low refrigerant or thermostat problems. An inspection can identify the actual cause.

title: Do you provide AC repair for apartments and villas in Al Sufouh?
desc: Yes, we provide Home AC Repair for apartments, villas and other residential properties, along with Commercial AC Repair for offices, shops and businesses.

title: Is Same Day AC Repair available in Al Sufouh?
desc: Same-day service may be available depending on technician schedules, location and the type of AC fault. Contacting the service team early can help with availability.

title: What causes an AC to leak water?
desc:
Common reasons include:
  • Blocked drain line
  • Frozen evaporator coil
  • Dirty air filter
The unit should be checked if the leakage continues.

title: What does AC maintenance include?
desc: A typical maintenance visit may include filter cleaning, coil inspection, drain cleaning, thermostat testing and cooling performance checks.

title: Do you provide AC Gas Refill in Al Sufouh?
desc: Yes, when low refrigerant is confirmed during inspection. The technician should first check why the refrigerant level has dropped before carrying out a refill.

title: Why does my AC smell bad when it starts?
desc: A bad smell can come from dust, moisture, mold or bacteria inside the unit. AC cleaning can remove buildup from filters, coils and drainage areas.

title: Why is my AC making a buzzing sound?
desc: Buzzing can be caused by loose electrical connections, fan problems, vibration or worn internal parts. The source should be inspected before the problem becomes worse.

title: Which AC brands do you repair?
desc: Our technicians work with major brands such as Daikin, LG, Samsung, Carrier, York, Mitsubishi, O General, Panasonic, Gree and other common AC brands.

title: Can AC cleaning help reduce electricity use?
desc: Yes, dirty filters and coils can restrict airflow and make the system work harder. Regular cleaning helps the cooling unit operate more efficiently.

title: How long can an air conditioner last?
desc: An AC's lifespan depends on how well it is maintained. If you keep it maintained by regular servicing, it helps to reduce unexpected breakdowns and it works longer.

title: Is an Annual Maintenance Contract worth having?
desc: An AMC can be useful for systems that run frequently. Scheduled inspections help identify developing faults early and keep routine servicing on track.

title: How much does AC repair cost in Al Sufouh?
desc: The repair price depends on the AC type, fault, required parts and amount of work. An inspection can identify the problem before the final repair cost is confirmed.

title: How can I book AC service in Al Sufouh?
desc: Share your location, AC problem and preferred appointment time with FAJ Technical Services L.L.C. The team can then arrange a suitable service visit.
